Name: MobyDick
Author: zr00000000
Description:
This uses the raw text of Moby Dick, starting at Chapter 1. While the text itself is public domain, I found this at [url=https://github.com/coderbhupendra/deeplearning/blob/master/melville-moby_dick.txt]deeplearning/melville-moby_dick.txt at master · coderbhupendra/deeplearning · GitHub[/url].

Based off of the Audible audiobook length, this mod adds over 21 hours of content to the game.

I also intend to update the formatting so it better fits within the library pages, so check back soon.
